 Fifteen CFP Top 25 teams set for ESPN in Week 12, including a trio of ranked-on-ranked showdowns
 Press Release
 November 16, 2026
 Author
 Amanda Brooks 
 Contact(s)
 Amanda Brooks: Amanda.D.Brooks@espn.com ; @BrooksAD 
 Courtney Clawson: Courtney.Clawson@espn.com ; @CourtClawESPN 
 Copy Text to Clipboard Scroll to Schedule(s) Summary
 More than half of the CFP Top 25 play on ESPN networks Saturday, including six of the top 10: No. 1 Georgia, No. 3 Alabama, No. 4 UCLA, No. 6 Texas, No. 7 Miami and No. 8 Tennessee 
 Three ranked-on-ranked games: No. 21 LSU at No. 8 Tennessee and No. 1 Georgia at No. 17 South Carolina on ABC, plus No. 11 Kentucky at No. 22 Missouri on SEC Network 
 Disney+ offerings this week include Arkansas at No. 6 Texas, Virginia Tech at No. 7 Miami and College GameDay Built by The Home Depot from Coral Gables 
 Week 12 of the 2026-27 college football season delivers 15 CFP Top 25 teams to ESPN networks, including six of the top 10. The slate runs from Tuesday, Nov. 17, through Saturday, Nov. 21, across ABC, ESPN, ESPN2, ESPNU, SEC Network, ACC Network, ESPN+, SEC Network+, ESPN Radio and Disney+.
 ABC presents a quartet of ranked squads as part of its Saturday tripleheader. In primetime, top-ranked Georgia takes on No. 17 South Carolina on ABC Saturday Night Football Presented by Capital One . Chris Fowler , Kirk Herbstreit , Holly Rowe and Laura Rutledge will call the 4K Game of the Week at 7:30 p.m. ET. At noon, No. 10 BYU visits Kansas, with Bob Wischusen , Louis Riddick and Stormy Buonantony on the call. At 3:30 p.m., No. 21 LSU travels to No. 8 Tennessee, with Sean McDonough , Greg McElroy and Katie George announcing. The matchup is also available as an immersive viewing experience on Meta Quest  (via the TV App), featuring live 180-degree coverage and front-row views of the action.
 ESPN features four ranked teams Saturday. At noon, No. 13 Wake Forest faces off against Georgia Tech, with Joe Tessitore , Jesse Palmer and Kris Budden on the call. At 3:30 p.m., Arkansas takes on No. 6 Texas, with Dave Pasch , Dusty Dvoracek and Taylor McGregor announcing the action, which will also be on Disney+. At 7 p.m., Virginia Tech visits No. 7 Miami, with Tom Hart , Roddy Jones and Quint Kessenich on the mic for the ACC showdown, which is also on Disney+ and the destination for College GameDay Built by The Home Depot . The day concludes at 10:15 p.m. with No. 25 Oklahoma State at Arizona State, featuring Roy Philpott , Brock Osweiler and Sherree Burruss . Additionally in primetime, SEC Network spotlights No. 11 Kentucky at No. 22 Missouri at 7:30 p.m., with Matt Schumacker , Aaron Murray and Taylor Davis on the call.
 Saturday also brings a collection of storied rivalries to ESPN networks. The 142nd edition of ‘The Game’ features Yale and Harvard at Fenway Park at 3:30 p.m. on ESPNU, with Eric Frede and Jack Ford on the mic, while The Big Game between Stanford and California closes the televised rivalry roster at 7:30 p.m. on ACC Network, featuring Wes Durham , Max Browne and Madison Fitzpatrick announcing the action. Additionally on Saturday, ESPN+ is streaming Lehigh-Lafayette at 12:30 p.m., Montana-Montana State at 2 p.m., Jackson State-Alcorn State at 3 p.m., Florida A&M-Bethune-Cookman at 3:30 p.m. and Idaho-Idaho State at 6 p.m.
 ESPN Radio will carry a pair of ranked-team matchups Saturday, beginning with No. 20 Ohio State at Nebraska, with Mike Couzens , Jordan Reid and Mike Peasley calling the action starting with a 30-minute pregame show at 11:30 a.m. At 3 p.m., No. 4 UCLA visits Michigan, with ESPN Radio’s top team of Marc Kestecher , Kelly Stouffer and Ian Fitzsimmons announcing the action from Ann Arbor.
 Additional Highlighted Games 
 Thursday, Nov. 19 | Rice at Temple | 7:30 p.m. on ESPN | Matt Barrie , Chase Daniel , Paul Carcaterra 
 Friday, Nov. 20 | Clemson at Duke | 7:30 p.m. on ESPN | Mike Monaco , Jordan Rodgers , Dana Boyle 
 Saturday, Nov. 21 | Texas A&M at Oklahoma | 3:45 p.m. on ESPN2 | Lowell Galindo , Kirk Morrison , Dawn Davenport 
 NCAA Division II and Division III Football Championships live on ESPN+ 
The road to the national championship begins Saturday on ESPN+, with all 16 first-round games from the 32-team NCAA Division II Football Championship and eight first-round matchups from the 40-team NCAA Division III Football Championship. Division II action begins at 1 p.m., while the Division III slate kicks off at noon, with every first-round game available on ESPN+. Full ESPN schedule for the 2026-27 NCAA Fall Championships .
 Schedules are subject to change. Please visit ESPNPressRoom.com and @ESPNPR for the latest updates on schedules, on-air teams and more.

These features are available to all fans who watch on the ESPN App on mobile and connected TV devices, whether they subscribe directly or through a pay TV package from certain providers. Bundling options available for fans include a Disney+, Hulu, and ESPN offering that provides a one-of-a-kind streaming package combining sports with branded and general entertainment.
